contracts.description: Drafts that check enforces continuously and via check --all.

oneOf.description: Path to a draft, checked against the config's own directory.

root.description: Directory the draft describes. Defaults to the config's directory.

templates.description: Template directory. template: values resolve inside it and apply writes their bytes verbatim.

annotations.description: Custom attribute vocabulary. Declared attributes complete and hover like built-ins, and check validates their value shape.

name.description: Attribute name, used as key or key: value in containers.

value.description: Value shape check enforces. A flag takes no value.

doc.description: Shown in editor hover and completion.

appliesTo.description: Which entries the attribute completes on.
